name: To Valanaar

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist is the commander of the peacekeepers stationed on the island, operating out of the settlement of Valanaar. Responsible for safeguarding the local populace, she finds her small garrison stretched thin as cultist activity escalates across the region.

Aonda is a crafty highlander stationed in the village of Shen'dar. After successfully securing a local pylon and defending the settlement from cultist incursions, she entrusts travelers to deliver her written report across the island to Valennia.

Valanaar is a settlement located at the southeastern edge of the island. It serves as the primary base for Valennia Stormfist and the local peacekeepers, acting as a defensive bastion for the island's townsfolk.

The island faces a rapidly growing cult threat that has begun encroaching on local settlements and sacred pylons. While peacekeepers previously avoided direct clashes, the cult's expansion now forces Valanaar and its defenders to prepare for an inevitable fight.
faq.q: What is the cult threatening the island?

faq.answer: Shen'dar is a village situated near a vital pylon on the island. Having recently repelled cultist aggression to keep the village and pylon secure, its leaders maintain close ties with the peacekeeper forces stationed in Valanaar.

The written report details the recent events surrounding the defense of Shen'dar and its pylon, warning Valennia that the cult's rapid territorial growth means direct conflict can no longer be avoided.
faq.q: What is contained in Aonda's report?

sections.body: Following the defense of the village of Shen'dar and its crucial pylon, the highlander Aonda dispatches a trusted messenger across the island. The destination is Valanaar, a settlement perched on the island's southeastern edge, where the commander of the local peacekeepers must be warned of the cult's rapid escalation.
sections.title: Dispatch from Shen'dar

sections.body: For some time, the peacekeepers under Valennia Stormfist have sought to prevent an open clash with the enigmatic cult encroaching upon the island. However, the events at Shen'dar signal a turning point. With cultist influence surging, Valennia is forced to acknowledge that the era of avoidance is finished, leaving her dwindling contingent of peacekeepers to brace Valanaar for an imminent assault.
sections.title: The Gathering Storm

summary: "To Valanaar" is a delivery quest carrying urgent news from the village of Shen'dar to the peacekeeper garrison at Valanaar. It marks a critical escalation on the island, alerting Commander Valennia Stormfist that peacekeepers can no longer avoid open conflict with the rapidly expanding cult.
